title: Algorithm Design & Analysis
summary: Sixteen implementations covering sorting, searching, dynamic programming, graphs, greedy methods, and recursion. Includes run instructions, examples, and documented limitations.

title: Operating Systems — CPU Scheduling
summary: Six scheduling policies: FCFS, Round Robin, SPN, SRTF, HRRN, and MLFQ. Includes corrected code, Gantt charts, scheduling metrics, original source, and 13 automated tests.

title: Computational Intelligence — Optimization Benchmarks
summary: 27 numerical objectives, seeded noise, evaluation budgets, and a documented PSO/GA experiment runner. Optimizer modules are pending; eight tests validate supplied components.

title: Theory of Computation — DFA Visualizer
summary: Eight-state binary automaton with optional interactive visualization, explicit acceptance, reset and undo. Seven tests cover all 16 transitions and 8,191 input strings; GUI execution remains unverified.

title: Programming — Hill Cipher & Sudoku
summary: Reviewed 3×3 Hill Cipher encryption and a Sudoku backtracking solver with input validation, source provenance, build instructions, and nine compiled regression tests.
